tei:div.tei:p: His Name is praised by the community of His portion, His praise is proclaimed by the holy Erelim and in His sanctuary everything utters glory of the Holy One.

Those who observe His commandments will yet return to the fortress, those who fear Him, speak to one another in purity and bliss, and the Lord has listened and heard and it is inscribed in the book of remembrance, the Holy One.
Improve your deeds that the covenant may not be broken, He who has adorned the skies, will hear your cry, and it will be more pleasing than the sacrifice of oxen to the Lord the Holy One.
Let the tribes of those Thou hast called, arise and rule, cut off the branches of enemies and let them fall, for both kingdom and ruler belong to the Lord, the Holy One.
May our exiled ascend from afar His holy mountain that we may praise Him always in His Inner Sanctuary, for He has remembered His holy word, the Holy One.
All inhabitants of the world and dwellers on earth do constantly say: Great things has the Lord performed on earth, and the Lord shall be King over all the earth, the Holy One.

Glorification and praise willingly do I bestow, I order prayer in speech and thought, I call upon the supreme God. On the day chosen from the mighty heavens for upright judgment to glorify His holiness, the Lord rules, the earth rejoices. The world is too small to contain His loftiness, who is there able to describe His might? King of all the earth is God, then sing with understanding.

May all His creatures acquire perception and know how great is His might. A memorial has He established for His wonders. He has firmly planted His foundation stone (Torah), the divine gift, so as to rejoice in His people. He remembers His covenant for ever.
He has inscribed my thoughts through a statute of the faith so as to remember me year by year, for a remembrance in the sanctuary of the Lord.

When the holy sacrifice (Isaac) once found favour in His eyes, He allowed a ram to be sacrificed in his stead, which was later caught with his horns in the thicket. He taught the descendants of (Isaac) to blow the Shofar on this new moon; but if this day falls on a Sabbath, then the mere mention of Teruah is a sacred proclamation. When it falls on a weekday for you, let it be blown in all your regions, let it be a day of Teruah for you.

Exalted is the rock of my salvation in the mouths of all peoples. Expose Thine arm to help us against adversaries, Thy realm is a realm of all eternity. When Thou revealest Thyself before all eyes to visit once again Thy dwelling place, congregations in their myriads will proclaim aloud: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever. Becoming to Thee is honour and the acknowledgment of might pronounced by the earth and its inhabitants and all the isles: who does not fear Thee, King of the nations.

Break the yoke of adversaries, destroy them; gather those dispersed by Thee and redeem them without ransom. Remember Thy congregation which Thou hast once chosen. Comfort the noblest of peoples, expose to their faces the shame of those who rise against them; remember, O Lord, against the sons of Edom the day of Jerusalem. Make even our highway, straighten it for our steps that the foot of Thy favourite may not stumble, as Thou hast said: I will surely still remember him.

The joyful city, sanctum and porch, and the altar may He restore with all the sacred vessels; the Lord will reign for ever. Heaven and earth exult at His Name; forests clap their hands in delight in Him; for the Lord has considered His people. The mighty Erelim and the bright stars in glory will proclaim His praise. Praise Him with the Shofar blast.

tei:p.tei:seg: All the inhabitants of the world and dwellers on earth do constantly say: Great things has the Lord performed on earth, and the Lord shall be King over all the earth, the Holy One.

tei:div.tei:p: He judges the world in justice and nations in righteousness, God is holy.
He is unique, who can reply to Him? Whatever His soul desires, He accomplishes, Awe-inspiring and Holy!
